import pytest

from ansible.plugins.lookup import url as url_lookup


@pytest.fixture
def configured_lookup(monkeypatch):
    lookup = url_lookup.LookupModule()
    options = {
        "validate_certs": False,
        "use_proxy": False,
        "username": "user",
        "password": "password",
        "headers": {"X-Test": "value"},
        "force": True,
        "timeout": 17,
        "http_agent": "test-agent",
        "force_basic_auth": True,
        "follow_redirects": "all",
        "use_gssapi": True,
        "unix_socket": "/tmp/test.sock",
        "ca_path": "/tmp/test-ca.pem",
        "unredirected_headers": ["Authorization"],
        "split_lines": True,
    }
    set_options_calls = []

    def fake_set_options(**kwargs):
        set_options_calls.append(kwargs)

    def fake_get_option(name):
        return options[name]

    monkeypatch.setattr(lookup, "set_options", fake_set_options)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lookup, "get_option", fake_get_option)

    return lookup, options, set_options_calls


def test_run_splits_response_lines_and_passes_all_url_options(
    configured_lookup, monkeypatch
):
    lookup, options, set_options_calls = configured_lookup
    responses = {
        "https://one.example": b"one\ntwo\n",
        "https://two.example": b"three\r\nfour",
    }
    read_counts = {term: 0 for term in responses}
    open_url_calls = []

    class Response:
        def __init__(self, term):
            self.term = term

        def read(self):
            read_counts[self.term] += 1
            return responses[self.term]

    def fake_open_url(term, **kwargs):
        open_url_calls.append((term, kwargs))
        return Response(term)

    monkeypatch.setattr(url_lookup, "open_url", fake_open_url)

    variables = {"inventory_hostname": "test-host"}
    result = lookup.run(
        list(responses),
        variables=variables,
        custom_direct_option="custom-value",
    )

    expected_url_options = {
        key: value for key, value in options.items() if key != "split_lines"
    }
    assert result == ["one", "two", "three", "four"]
    assert set_options_calls == [
        {
            "var_options": variables,
            "direct": {"custom_direct_option": "custom-value"},
        }
    ]
    assert open_url_calls == [
        (term, expected_url_options) for term in responses
    ]
    assert read_counts == {term: 1 for term in responses}


def test_run_returns_unsplit_response(configured_lookup, monkeypatch):
    lookup, options, set_options_calls = configured_lookup
    options["split_lines"] = False
    term = "https://example.test"
    response_body = b"complete response\nwith newlines"
    read_count = 0
    open_url_calls = []

    class Response:
        def read(self):
            nonlocal read_count
            read_count += 1
            return response_body

    def fake_open_url(received_term, **kwargs):
        open_url_calls.append((received_term, kwargs))
        return Response()

    monkeypatch.setattr(url_lookup, "open_url", fake_open_url)

    result = lookup.run([term], variables={"host": "example"})

    expected_url_options = {
        key: value for key, value in options.items() if key != "split_lines"
    }
    assert result == ["complete response\nwith newlines"]
    assert set_options_calls == [
        {"var_options": {"host": "example"}, "direct": {}}
    ]
    assert open_url_calls == [(term, expected_url_options)]
    assert read_count == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("error_kind", "expected_prefix", "expected_detail"),
    [
        ("http", "Received HTTP error for", "unavailable"),
        ("url", "Failed lookup url for", "offline"),
        ("ssl", "Error validating the server's certificate for", "certificate"),
        ("connection", "Error connecting to", "connection refused"),
    ],
)
def test_run_translates_url_errors(
    configured_lookup,
    monkeypatch,
    error_kind,
    expected_prefix,
    expected_detail,
):
    lookup, options, set_options_calls = configured_lookup
    term = "https://failure.example"
    open_url_calls = []

    if error_kind == "http":
        error = url_lookup.HTTPError(
            term, 503, "unavailable", {}, None
        )
    elif error_kind == "url":
        error = url_lookup.URLError("offline")
    elif error_kind == "ssl":
        error = url_lookup.SSLValidationError("certificate validation failed")
